description: Locally hosted CC0 and public-domain baseball demo media. Three direct recordings by D. Benjamin Miller and a continuous 3-minute Universal Newsreel excerpt published by the U.S. National Archives.

items.title: Tim Peterson's delivery
items.author: D. Benjamin Miller
modifications: Transcoded the complete original to H.264 MP4 (yuv420p, CRF 25, faststart).

The original has no audio stream; no audio added.
Extracted the JPEG poster from the converted video at 2 seconds.
No subtitles, logos, speech, or other creative content added.

items.title: 1955 World Series: Dodgers and Yankees — first 3 minutes
items.author: Universal Newsreel / Universal Pictures; preserved and published by the U.S. National Archives
items.license: Public domain — dedicated by Universal Pictures
modifications: Selected one continuous excerpt from 00:00 to 03:00 of the official NARA video; no looping or rearrangement.
Transcoded to H.264 MP4, yuv420p, 24 fps, faststart; scaled proportionally to fit 640×480.
Original audio transcoded to AAC at 64 kbps.
Extracted the JPEG poster from the converted video at 60 seconds.
Manual scene descriptions are separate browser demo fixtures, not AI output or speech transcription.

rightsVerification.sourceStatement: Official National Archives Special Media Division blog provides the Universal Newsreel baseball story as a downloadable MP4.
rightsVerification.licenseStatement: The National Archives states that Universal Pictures donated the collection and placed it in the public domain.
rightsVerification.catalogNote: The NARA blog refers to both Release 714 and Release 713; the download URL is retained verbatim rather than resolving that catalog inconsistency.

audioReview.method: ffmpeg volumedetect over the complete converted 180-second excerpt
audioReview.conclusion: Audio track contains a non-silent signal; the original audio was retained.
